purpose: Clarify and harmonize all file-count and directory-count statements across interim and review reports.

197_files_count.definition: Exact count of files explicitly listed across the internal package manifest files (SHA256SUMS.txt).

202_raw_files_count.definition: Complete count of physical files residing on disk within the three raw package directories.
202_raw_files_count.reconciliation_difference: +5 files: The 3 SHA256SUMS.txt manifest files themselves plus 2 package-level README/metadata files not indexed inside their own checksum catalogs.

26_interim_files_count.definition: Complete count of physical files generated under data/interim/.

11_frozen_benchmark_directories.origin: Reported consistently in all interim and review audits.
11_frozen_benchmark_directories.definition: Historical benchmark directories under results/ that remain bitwise identical.

final_standardized_statement: For final reporting, the project uses 202 raw physical files on disk (or 197 manifest-indexed package files), 26 interim derived files, and 11 frozen benchmark directories.
